verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for an identity-verification SaaS that handles sensitive biometric and document data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions region selection, data residency, or a choice of storage location; the items cover sessions, SDKs, webhooks, HMAC security and pricing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
